summary: Implement the United States official-numbering adapter
description: Combine permitted NANPA and regulator evidence without treating numbering-plan validity as caller identity.
acceptance: R-1: The adapter resolves covered US numbering evidence from pinned public-safe fixtures with provenance and freshness.
R-2: Reserved example numbers remain distinguishable from assignable and assigned numbers.

review_history.evidence: R-1 approved: seven focused tests prove covered US numbering context resolves from pinned NANPA facts with FCC regulatory context, complete provenance, declared freshness, and schema-valid evidence. R-2 approved: NPA-level assignment status and line-level fictional reservation remain separately scoped, no exact-number/provider/subscriber/caller inference exists, and unpinned, unsupported, and stale results are explicit. All 78 repository tests and public-safety gates pass.
